description: This file defines the React component 'Appearance' which provides a preferences UI for choosing themes and appearance settings in a web application. It manages theme selection, system color scheme usage, and incorporates imported components and hooks for rendering and logic.

classes.name: Appearance
classes.description: React functional component for preferences appearance settings, including theme selection and system color scheme usage.

methods.name: toggleUseDeviceSettings
methods.description: Toggles whether to use system color scheme settings and updates preferences accordingly.

methods.name: changeAutoLightTheme
methods.description: Handles updating the auto light theme preference; activates premium modal if feature is premium.

methods.name: changeAutoDarkTheme
methods.description: Handles updating the auto dark theme preference; activates premium modal if feature is premium.
